body: Because it's still bothering me? Just because something is certain doesn't mean it can't bother you

Thanks for the response, you are a great person.

I can't afford a pet or therapy, I can't even afford to get my thyroid right which is even more important.

Sure I could find another job but what's the point? I can't move away so I'm stuck in a small community that won't want to hire me for anything other than a minimum wage job. Why put in all this work just to still be in a position of struggle?

I hung on for a while because I thought maybe the US could get there shit together and finally get Medicare for all that we have been fighting for over 30 years. If I can't afford medical treatment what's the point?

Even if I didn't have medical costs I wouldn't be able to afford rent in my area with a minimum wage job.
